name: How it works, countdown
description: Giant outlined numerals count down to one across a bold colour band, ending on a single closing word.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Your bike back on the road by Friday

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: No booking form and no three-week queue at Spoke & Sprocket. Most repairs take four working days, start to finish.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: What happens before the count reaches one.

default.title: Drop it off
default.text: Wheel it in any morning from 8. We look it over with you at the stand and write down what it needs.

default.title: We call with a price
default.text: One call before closing time with a fixed price and a pick-up day. Nothing is fitted until you say yes.

default.title: Pick it up
default.text: Tuned, test-ridden round the block and wiped down. Pay at the counter by cash or card.

fields.name: finale
fields.label: Closing word
fields.help: Shown large after the last number. Leave empty to hide it.
